A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Darmstadtium (다름슈타튬) itself — the sovereign of the Darmstadtium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a glamorous, sultry allure; olive skin; diamond-shaped face with softly defined cheekbones and a tapered chin; eyes of natural size — almond eyes whose outer corners lift slightly, outer eye corners slightly lifted; gently arched, slender brows; petite straight nose; soft, full lips; jade-green eyes; sharp winged eyeliner.
Body and hair: pear-shaped and curvaceous — slimmer shoulders over a narrow waist, full rounded hips and thick thighs, a full bust build; a loose messy bun with fallen strands with wispy see-through bangs; deep plum hair scattered with tiny glinting gold-mosaic flecks and one straight turquoise streak.
Expression: a faint knowing smile.
Her element, carried in her design: darmstadtium: a heavy synthetic metal below platinum, first made in 1994 by striking lead with nickel ions fired down a long straight accelerator in a research city that found six new elements, and named for that city, where an art-nouveau artists' colony was built on a hill in 1899 around a tall brick tower crowned with five rounded fingers and walls of golden mosaic, and where electrical engineering was first taught as a university subject.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Deep plum and gold-mosaic knight plate with big rounded pauldrons and layered plates below the waist, every plate inlaid with tiny glinting gold tesserae, a straight turquoise ion-beam line running down the centre from collar to hem, warm brick-red trim, a slender crown-like head ornament with five rounded finger-like points instead of a helmet; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: mecha armor shaped like a medieval knight's plate — big rounded pauldrons, a breastplate, layered plates below the waist, a head ornament instead of a helmet so her face shows. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: art-nouveau gold mosaic, deep plum, ion-beam turquoise, warm brick red.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, a linear accelerator city: a city built along a straight accelerator corridor kilometres long running to the horizon, a turquoise ion beam racing down it, and a target hall clad in golden mosaic panels where heavy beams collide.
This card: in a target hall clad in golden mosaic panels.
Pose: Standing turned three-quarters toward the camera, weight on one leg, one hand resting at her side or hip.
Time & weather: clear daylight, crisp shadows.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Ds) and atomic number (110) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
